custom_args.empty_hint: Add the first token to build the launch command.

mcp_config.dialog_description: Choose a connection method and enter its settings. Switch to JSON for advanced configuration.
mcp_config.dialog_command_hint: The executable that starts the server, from the server's install docs — e.g. npx, uvx, or an absolute path. Arguments go in the fields below, not here.
mcp_config.dialog_url_hint: The MCP endpoint published by the service or given by your deployment admin — a homepage URL won't work here.
mcp_config.dialog_snippet_hint: Paste what the server's install docs give you — a {"mcpServers": {...}} block, a single server object, a launch command line, or an endpoint URL. Applying only fills in the fields below; it never runs a command.
mcp_config.dialog_snippet_not_object: The snippet must be a JSON object.
mcp_config.dialog_snippet_no_servers: The snippet's server list is empty.
mcp_config.dialog_snippet_multiple: The snippet defines more than one server ({{names}}) — paste one at a time.
mcp_config.dialog_snippet_missing_target: The snippet needs a command or a url.
mcp_config.dialog_snippet_unbalanced: The command line has an unclosed quote.
mcp_config.dialog_snippet_unsupported: The command line uses unsupported shell syntax (pipes, redirects, expansions, or a dangling backslash) — paste a single launch command.

composio_mcp.empty_hint: You haven't connected any third-party services. Authorize one first, then come back here to allow it.

runtime_config.intro: Choose how the OpenClaw runtime executes this agent's turns. Local mode runs the agent inside the daemon process. Gateway mode forwards each turn to an OpenClaw Gateway — useful when the daemon host is a lightweight coordinator and the agent should run on a more powerful machine.
runtime_config.gateway_hint: Only used in Gateway mode. Every field is optional — a blank field is inherited from the daemon host's gateway config (`~/.openclaw/openclaw.json`, `gateway` section). A saved token is the exception: leaving it blank keeps the saved value.
runtime_config.host_hint: The gateway address, from your deployment admin. Blank inherits the host's config.
runtime_config.token_hint: Issued by the gateway — get it from your deployment admin or the gateway host's config. When none is set, blank inherits.
runtime_config.token_hint_saved: A token is saved — leaving this field blank keeps it. Enter a new value to replace it.

skills.intro: This is the agent's effective skill set. Workspace skills are managed here; inherited Codex and Claude Code skills can also be turned off per agent.
skills.empty_hint: Add workspace skills to share team knowledge with this agent.
skills.add_dialog_description: Select a workspace skill to assign to this agent.

integrations.intro: Connect this agent to external chat platforms so people can work with it where they already are.
